_about: Every benchmark set the paper quotes, tagged by what its numbers can show (plan 28 Task 2, ruling Q19). make_numbers.py reads this file and labels each key with its set and tag; a key naming a set not listed here stops it. A tag starts with tuning, regression or unseen; a set pooling others takes the least clean of their tags.

_legend.tuning: constants, rules or limits were chosen while looking at this set's results: its numbers describe the fit, not generalisation
_legend.regression: looked at before the number quoted (failures fixed, or used as a gate while the code changed), but not used to choose constants: a guard against regressions, not evidence on unseen structures
_legend.unseen: measured once, with no change aimed at it before the measurement quoted

r100_tuned.reason: the sample the layout's constants were tuned on and whose failures were fixed (docs/validation/fourth-sample-protocol.md; claims table R2)

r100_held_first.what: random-100 sample 2 (docs/validation/random100-heldout/, seed 20261017), its first run, as judged at 1ef0706
r100_held_first.reason: run once before any fix aimed at it (drawings at 5650dbd, 8 redrawn at 44a1c1b after the check corrections of F1 fix round 1); its count describes 5650dbd, not the release: a historical count by design

r100_held.what: random-100 sample 2 (docs/validation/random100-heldout/, seed 20261017), as rerun at 7696947
r100_held.reason: held out at first, then the input of plan 15, which fixed its failures with new rules and limits chosen while looking at them: the membrane estimate's slab fallback and chain rule (Task 6, a963bb6; 7VVK then passing at 0.149 against a 0.15 limit) and the per-page window pool of 8M nodes (final fix round, e5b4bae) (.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-17-15-heldout-failures/progress.md; fourth-sample-protocol.md)

r100_third.reason: drawn and run once at 7696947 with no fix aimed at it; code changed after that run (e5b4bae, then plans 16-28), so its count describes 7696947, not the release (fourth-sample-protocol.md)

r100_fourth.what: random-100 sample 4 (docs/validation/random100-fourth/, seed 20261025), not drawn yet
r100_fourth.reason: drawn and run once at the frozen release under docs/validation/fourth-sample-protocol.md, excluding every id of samples 1-3; the paper's headline count

r100_pooled.reason: pools sample 1, the tuning sample, with samples 2 and 3

na_benchmark.reason: its limits were set from its measured campaign (nacheck.THRESHOLDS) and its failures fixed in the NA layout (docs/validation/na/review.md)

dom_cal.what: the 22 domain calibration chains (tests/data/domains/cath_reference.json minus the chain-by-chain held third)
dom_cal.reason: the domain parameters were chosen on them (domain_score.held_out docstring)

dom_held.what: the 11 domain chains held out chain by chain (seed 20261016:domains)
dom_held.reason: homologues of tuning chains present (6FY9/6FYF, 2YBE/3PGK, the hexokinases), and the split was looked at twice while the parameters were chosen, so not untouched (domain_score.held_out docstring)

dom_held_nohom.what: the held chains with no tuning chain in the same CATH homology group
dom_held_nohom.reason: a subset of dom_held: the same split, looked at twice

dom_reference.what: all 33 reference chains (dom_cal and dom_held pooled)

dom_fresh.what: tests/data/domains/cath_fresh.json: 11 chains of superfamilies none of the 33 has
dom_fresh.reason: never tuned on (domain_score.held_out docstring), but gated in CI while the code changed: tests/test_domain_score.py fails if its mean overlap drops below .70

hom_heldout.what: plan 13a's held-out homologue pairs (docs/validation/homologues/heldout.json: 30 positive, 10 negative)
hom_heldout.reason: one run at c099787 with the limits frozen at 76fd936 on the tuning set; nothing changed after the run; its count describes c099787, not the release (reruns since give 17 of 30 positives against the frozen 16; docs/validation/homologues/review.md)

hom_usalign.what: the homologue tuning and held-out pairs pooled, foldmap's aligner against US-align (plan 23 Task 3)
hom_usalign.reason: pools the tuning pairs the like-limits were frozen on; measured once, after the held-out run

dssp_m2.what: the protein entries of random-100 samples 1-3 whose file mkdssp reads (M2: foldmap's DSSP against mkdssp 3.1.2)

membrane_opm.what: the membrane stratum of random-100 samples 1-3 that OPM publishes an oriented file for (data/opm/selection.json)
membrane_opm.reason: chosen by a stated rule before any foldmap result, but it pools sample 1, the tuning sample, and the membrane rules were then chosen against it: plan 27 Task 3 changed the plane rule with the target of 7VVK and 7PIU within about 10 degrees of OPM (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-24-27-membrane-by-construction.md), and plan 15 Task 6's rules (a963bb6) are attributed on it

determinism.what: the committed test structures, drawn on Linux, macOS and Windows (scripts/paper/determinism.py)
determinism.reason: the test suite's own structures: a reproducibility guard, not a sample

pub.reason: the figures the layout was judged against during development
